plugins.name: Market
plugins.author: Ryoku Team
plugins.tagline: Track a stock, index, or crypto pair on your desktop.
plugins.description: A desktop-widget plugin that tracks any Yahoo Finance symbol - a crypto pair (BTC-USD), a stock (AAPL), or an index (^GSPC) - and renders its live price, change, and history in one of four faces: a dossier hero with a layered 2.5D ridgeline chart, a gridded line, a gradient area, or a compact minimal sparkline. Drawn in the shell's own dark carbon style, drag it onto your wallpaper beside the clock and weather. Free data, no API key.

plugins.name: Photo Frame
plugins.author: Ryoku Team
plugins.tagline: Pin a photo to your desktop, framed the way you like it.
plugins.description: A desktop-widget plugin that pins any photo to your wallpaper in a chosen frame style - rounded, square, polaroid, framed, or film - with a tunable drop shadow and live colour filters (mono, noir, sepia, warm, cool, vivid, fade). Drag, resize, and place it alongside your clock and weather; it ships with a sample photo so it looks right the moment you enable it.
